reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.text: What is actually going on with this scam? Filter for nut free recipes & immediately shows me an almond milk recipe? Filter for sugar free recipes & immediately shows chocolate & candy cane dessert pops? Scan a barcode for auto upload of calories & it’s inaccurate by a tripe count?

reviews.title: Numbers are lies
reviews.text: I did a keto diet and wanted to get back into it. To see if it was giving accurate numbers I put my fridge ingredients as chicken, peas, corn, green beans, cheese, milk, eggs, potatoes, rice, broth. It gave me a recipe with 2 cups of rice and said it was only .61 ounces carb. Thats a total lie. Then it gave me a potato dish with 2 russet potatoes and said .16ounces carb. Again a huge lie! Do not waste your money on this!!!!
